heading: Your tickets
closed: Ticket sales closed when the event started.
empty: You haven’t chosen any tickets yet.

buyer.heading: Your details
buyer.lead: The order is in your name. We send it to your email address, with a link to your tickets.
buyer.emailHelp: Your order and its link come to this address.

people.heading: Who is coming
people.lead: Each ticket is for one person, named here. Their email and phone are their own: yours are never used for them.
people.emailHelp: Only for this person’s own messages from the hosts.

venue.lead: Answer at least one place. Any left open can be answered later.

agreements.heading: Before the door
agreements.lead: After the order, each person with an email address receives their own link to agree to:
agreements.noEmail: Anyone without an email address gets the link from the hosts. Nobody can be let in without agreeing.

promo.heading: Promo code
promo.label: Code
promo.busy: Too many tries in a short time. Wait a minute, then try again.
promo.failed: The code couldn’t be checked. Try again. Reference: {{requestId}}

reasons.unavailable: This code is no longer available.
reasons.otherEvent: This code isn’t for this event.
reasons.notYet: This code can’t be used yet.
reasons.ranOut: This code has been used up.
reasons.minimum: This code needs an order of at least {{amount}}.

total.heading: Total
total.label: To pay
total.freeNote: Your tickets appear on the next page, and come to your email address.
total.paidNote: You pay on your bank’s own secure page. Your tickets are held for you for 15 minutes.

refusals.staleRevision: The hosts changed how guests answer while you were filling this in. Choose again where each person is coming; everything else you typed is kept.
refusals.changedIntent: Your order changed since you last pressed. Press again to place it as it is now.
refusals.soldOut: There are fewer tickets left than you chose. Your tickets above now show what is left: check them, then press again.
refusals.notOnSale: One of your tickets is no longer on sale. Your tickets above show what is left: check them, then press again.
refusals.salesClosed: Ticket sales have closed for this event, or for one of your tickets.
refusals.salesNotOpen: Sales for one of your tickets haven’t opened yet.
refusals.orderLimits: One of your tickets is sold only in other quantities. Change your tickets, then press again.
refusals.requiredAnswer: A question the hosts require isn’t answered for everyone coming. It is marked above.
refusals.notFound: This event is no longer on sale here.
refusals.paymentsOff: Paid tickets can’t be bought yet: Aveline is running as a free pilot. Free tickets can still be had.
refusals.fields: Some details were refused. They are marked above.
refusals.rateLimited: Too many tries in a short time. Wait a minute, then press again.
refusals.noAnswer: We didn’t get an answer. Press again: your order won’t be placed twice.
refusals.other: The order was refused, with this reason:
refusals.promo: {{reason}} Remove the code, or try another.
refusals.layoutChanged: The layout changed. Choose your seats or zones again.
refusals.selectionUnavailable: A selection is unavailable. Choose your seats or zones again.
refusals.buyerLimit: This order exceeds the event’s ticket limit per buyer.

errors.email: Enter an email address, like name@example.com.
errors.buyerOnce: Only one ticket can be yours.

selection.heading: Choose seats or zones
selection.soldOut: No places are available for this ticket.
selection.required: Choose a seat or zone for every ticket.
